en.headline: Five hikers fall ill amid hot weather on final day of Chung Yeung holiday
en.dek: Emergency services assisted five people in separate incidents, including an airlift from Sai Kung, as temperatures stayed high across the city.
body: Five hikers required emergency assistance in separate incidents on Monday as hot weather continued on the final day of the Chung Yeung Festival long weekend, according to reports.

In Sai Kung, a 62-year-old mainland Chinese woman hiking with friends near the High Island Reservoir East Dam at Po Pin Chau became dizzy and weak at about 10.30am. Suspected of suffering from heatstroke, she was rescued by the Government Flying Service and flown to hospital for treatment.

Later, at about 12.20pm, a family of three hiking from Tai Tong Country Park along the MacLehose Trail reported that the mother, in her fifties, felt unwell and vomited near Tai Lam Chung Reservoir. Details of the other incidents were not immediately available in initial reports.

The Hong Kong Observatory has forecast dry and hot conditions, with urban maximum temperatures around 32 degrees Celsius. The Yellow Fire Danger Warning remains in force, and hikers have been urged to stay vigilant and take precautions against heat.

zh.headline: 重陽假期最後一日炎熱天氣下五名行山人士不適需救援
zh.dek: 多宗獨立事件中五人需要緊急協助，包括西貢一名女子由飛行服務隊直升機接送入院，當日氣溫持續偏高。
body: 周一是重陽節長周末最後一日，炎熱天氣下有五名行山人士在不同事件中不適，需要緊急救援，據報道。
西貢破邊洲近萬宜水庫東壩，一名62歲內地女子與友人行山，約上午十時半感到頭暈及乏力，懷疑中暑，由政府飛行服務隊直升機接送入院治理。
約中午十二時二十分，一家三口從大棠郊野公園沿麥理浩徑行山，母親約五十多歲在大欖涌水庫附近感到不適並嘔吐。初步報道未有其他事件的詳細資料。
天文台預測天氣乾燥及炎熱，市區最高氣溫約32度。黃色火災危險警告仍然生效，呼籲行山人士提高警覺，並採取防暑措施。
